written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following revelations about personal relationships
written.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to relationships with a subordinate and a woman identified as a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor.

written.headline: Report details past clash between Jensen Huang and interim CEO Colette Kress
written.summary: A Wall Street Journal report revealed that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang privately called CFO Colette Kress “a deer in the headlights” during an August 2026 meeting about chip financing guarantees. Kress has since taken over as interim CEO following Huang's resignation.

written.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh
written.summary: ReNew Energy Global has announced an investment of approximately ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh to build a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean energy manufacturing facilities. The initiative aims to support India's growing digital economy and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

written.headline: Global Microsoft outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot and cloud services
written.summary: A global Microsoft outage beginning Thursday, November 12, disrupted Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Copilot, and third-party AI connectors for over 12 hours across multiple countries. The server failure impacted businesses, government agencies, and airlines, with Downdetector logging over 130,000 reports for Outlook alone.
